nodes.label: Project
nodes.rationale: A user-created workspace wrapping one uploaded event log plus its metadata and parsed data. Named Project rather than Workspace or analysis to avoid competing vocabulary.

nodes.label: Event Log
nodes.rationale: The parsed, typed table for a Project, persisted as Parquet after mapping is confirmed. One per Project, never re-derived from the raw upload.

nodes.label: Column Mapping
nodes.rationale: Correspondence between raw file columns and the fields process mining requires (case ID, activity, timestamp). Captured once at project creation; every column appears in it, meaningless ones carry role 'other'.

nodes.label: Project Draft
nodes.rationale: A chosen upload whose Column Mapping is not yet confirmed. Has no Project and no Event Log, so abandoning the flow leaves nothing behind.

nodes.label: Hidden Column
nodes.rationale: Excluded from all analysis, not merely from display: inert until un-hidden. Distinct from a column that is simply not shown.

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.rationale: An event-level predicate lifted to whole cases, its mode picking the lift (mandatory/forbidden/keep_selected/trim). Stored as a definition and re-evaluated on demand, never materialized, so filtering is non-destructive.

nodes.label: Slice
nodes.rationale: A named, ordered AND-chain of Filters and the population it produces. Order is user-visible and matters because each Filter applies to the previous one's output. Slices are the unit compared against each other.

nodes.label: Base Slice
nodes.rationale: The one Slice per Project whose chain prefixes every other Slice's chain, the shared cleanup before comparison. Created lazily so an unfiltered Project has no Slice rows at all.

nodes.label: Population
nodes.rationale: A set of cases the Statistics view puts in one column. The whole log is a Population but not a Slice: it has no chain and is never stored.

nodes.label: Distribution
nodes.rationale: Counts of one attribute's values over a node's events split by Group. Describes a shape rather than comparing Groups, so it carries no p-value and no Effect Direction.

nodes.label: Distribution Scope
nodes.rationale: Which of a node's cases' events are counted: 'At this step' vs 'Whole case'. The case set is identical either way; only which events count changes. Not called Variant scope because a non-leaf node sits on many Variants.

nodes.label: Local-First Process Mining App
nodes.rationale: A Tauri desktop app where users upload event logs and the app derives process maps, variants, statistics and a data table. All data stays on-device.
